edits.old: Then no second valuation_ext row, decision record or outbox row is written
edits.new:
Then no second valuation_ext row, decision record or outbox row is written

  Scenario: AC8 The reference-data values are read with their version and no case table is read or written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the reference-data contract fake returns the age limit, the freshness limit and the rule version in force
    When the route assessment runs POST /cases/{caseId}/route
    Then the limits used are those returned with their version and none is written in code
    Then the service writes no case table and reads no table of another service; the case arrives only as the path identifier

  Scenario: AC9 The route assessment answers 401, 403 and 404 as the contract states (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the route assessment is requested for a case
    When the request carries no valid credentials
    Then the request is refused with 401 and the platform problem body
    When the user does not hold right U in Treatment and offer
    Then the request is refused with 403 and the platform problem body
    When the case identifier does not exist
    Then the request is refused with 404 and the message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S1-E4002-APP-AC9)
    Then no valuation_ext row, outbox row or decision record is written
